info.name: Sonarfy - Echoes
info.description: Contract: docs/api/echoes.md. Execute requests individually with a test account that already authorized user-read-recently-played. Set accessToken locally and never export filled secrets. Provider Retry-After is preserved without shortening. Expired or replaced sync leases return 409; ineligible accounts rejected by authentication return 401. Each sync rescans up to three pages to recover earlier partial failures.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Sync summary fields", () => pm.expect(Object.keys(b).sort()).to.eql(["alreadyKnown", "complete", "fetched", "imported", "newestPlayedAt", "possibleGap", "skipped", "syncedAt"])); }
